title: Preserve global extended barlines and bar-number policy
scope: Add authored score-style support for BinaryStylesheet System/ExtendedBarLines and System/barIndexDrawType.
acceptance: Import and export explicit extended-barline true/false and numbering AllBars, FirstOfSystem and Hide, including wire integer values 0, 1 and 2.
Use pinned extended-barlines.gp and barnumbers-all/first/hide.gp fixtures. Verify exact keys/types, Go public values and pinned AlphaTab stylesheet values after export.
Preserve absence/default semantics without inventing per-bar ownership. Validate undefined authored policy values and malformed/truncated stylesheet records.
Make the shared stylesheet read/write path preserve other supported settings and provide a documented public edit contract; do not emit an empty replacement stylesheet that erases these settings.
exclusions: Per-bar barLineLeft/right and barNumberDisplay are not GP-authored at the pin. Final DoubleBar consumer normalization remains #95 and is not a prerequisite for these global keys.

reproduction.instructions: Import and export explicit extended-barline true/false and numbering AllBars, FirstOfSystem and Hide, including wire integer values 0, 1 and 2. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: implementation-ready: Pinned BinaryStylesheet apply/writeForScore supports both global keys. The current Go writer returns a zero-entry stylesheet, and the ZIP reader does not import these values.
